title: Synthesis and Tribological Characteristics of High-Performance Self-Lubricating CoCrFeNiMo<sub>x</sub>-Ni/MoS<sub>2</sub>-Ag-Cr<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> Composites.

recollection.intervention: Guess: addition of Mo, Ni, MoS2, Ag, and Cr2O3
recollection.structure: Guess: composite material with dispersed MoS2 and Cr2O3 phases
recollection.mechanism: Guess: self-lubrication through MoS2 and Ag, improved hardness and wear resistance through Cr2O3 and Ni
recollection.results: Guess: improved tribological properties, such as reduced friction coefficient and wear rate

score.note: The recollection only generically identifies the listed composite constituents and their expected lubricating roles. It misses the actual intervention—varying Mo content (x = 0.2, 0.5, 1)—and omits Mo-induced lattice distortion, σ-phase formation, temperature-dependent tribofilms, and glaze formation. Its hardness mechanism is also misassigned to Cr2O3/Ni rather than Mo solid-solution and σ-phase strengthening. No quantitative values or trends are recalled.
